# vendor

`u2netp.onnx` — U²-Net (the small model, u2netp), by Xuebin Qin et al., Apache-2.0
(https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net), as exported to ONNX by rembg (https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg, MIT).
The admin runs it in the browser with onnxruntime-web (MIT, from node_modules) to find the pair in a photo.
The build copies both into `admin/vendor/`.
